about: Pool Nation is the ultimate Pool Simulator for PlayStation®4. Prepare yourself for pixel perfect physics, photo-realistic graphics and super detailed visuals in this truly immersive representation of the sport.
Play live matches seamlessly online, compete in Leagues, share, challenge and enrol in the Pool Nation Cup, explore our unique rule set customisation tool and re-discover this much-loved sport.
Pool Nation flawlessly blends reality with the impossible, resulting in the finest example of digital pool you will ever play.
One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PlayStation is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
See Health Warnings for important health information before using this product.
